title: Playable C&C-style demo
author: eveningwithcats
selftext:
![img](58sz12mhzgwh1 "TIBERIAN GPT: TOKENSTORM")

Just a little hommage to Tiberian Sun and Stargate. Astra (high) made this. It took care of the assets and the code, and it produced a decent little demo. I can move around the vehicle and soldier, have different terrain heights and types and even a dialable gate. Pathfinding is in it as well.

I remember that my first RTS attempts some time ago where quite ok, but always lacked the good graphics. But since Codex knows how to code AND generate the proper images, it can just put it alltogether now. It only takes a couple of minutes. Iterating from her to a RTS prototype will probably only take 2 more sessions. 

  
What helped the most? Provide screenshots of the reference game. Explain some game mechanics and what is important to you. I am so happy that I can finally make all the games I ever wanted and just play them on my own.
